title: Weak and strong solutions for a class of quasilinear Allen--Cahn systems
summary: We consider a quasilinear Allen--Cahn system which arises when the gradient energy term in the Ginzburg--Landau energy also contains zero order terms. Such systems offer significant advantages in applications, since surface tensions and mobilities can be easily calibrated. The analysis for these systems is highly challenging, partly due to the fact that the gradient term in the energy is non-convex and since gradient terms appear quadratically in the weak formulation.
